{{Top|leg}}
An '''Eb''' was an [[Insect/Legends|insect]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]]. Their nests were protected against the [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]] that erupted from Kubindi's [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Ku'Bakai]].
